possible_explanations.statement: The half-hour operational demand observed at 2026-08-20 09:00 AEST (UTC+1000) being higher than the run's POE50 (ev0588) may reflect higher measured consumption or lower embedded generation/WDR in that half-hour.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare measured operational demand and any WDR/embedded generation telemetry for 2026-08-20 09:00 AEST (UTC+1000) with the pre-dispatch targets and unit SCADA for that same half-hour (use the operational demand value ev0556 and the forecast values ev0588/ev0590).

possible_explanations.statement: The five-minute RRP of 23.9901 $/MWh for the interval ending 2026-08-19T23:30:00Z (2026-08-20 09:30 AEST (UTC+1000)) may be associated with the dispatch TOTALDEMAND and net interconnector flows reported around that interval.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Inspect dispatch TOTALDEMAND and net interconnector flows for the five-minute intervals ending 2026-08-19T23:30:00Z and 2026-08-19T23:35:00Z (use totaldemand evidence ev0604 and ev0607, and netinterchange ev0608) alongside RRP ev0603 to evaluate how demand and interchange relate to price in those intervals.

uncertainties: Some later half-hour actuals and forecast pairs in the requested forecast window were not provably public by the as-of time, limiting a fuller forecast-vs-actual assessment for the entire window (see compare_forecast_actual 'missing' entries).
